verdict.rationale: Mercury says its AI reads vendor bills, fills in their details, and remembers past recipients so they can be approved and paid quickly. Bills can be routed through approval policies, and transactions can be categorized and synced to QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite. Nothing in the evidence shows invoices being matched to purchase orders, and coding happens at the transaction-category level rather than on the bill itself. Missing for 10: purchase-order matching, automatic GL coding of bills, an AP-specific bill API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI bill-pay flow.
